DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた物について伺います。どのようなかばんでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will ask about your lost item. What kind of bag is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い布の手提げです。昼にバスを降りたとき、持っていないことに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: なくした青い手提げと気づいた時点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a blue cloth tote bag. I noticed I did not have it when I got off the bus at lunchtime.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the blue tote bag you lost and when you noticed it was missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に手元にあったのは、バスに乗る前ですか、それとも車内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was the last time you had it before boarding the bus, or on the bus?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車内で膝の上に置いたのは覚えています。降りる直前にどこへ置いたかは、はっきりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車内で最後に確認した位置と不明な記憶を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I remember putting it on my lap on the bus. I am not sure where I put it just before getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the last confirmed position on the bus from what you do not clearly remember. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: バスの事業者にも車内の忘れ物を確認してください。こちらでは、特徴や中身を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check with the bus operator about items left on the bus. Here, we will record its features and contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取っ手に小さな猫の飾りがあります。中は弁当箱と灰色の折り畳み傘で、財布や身分証は入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 猫の飾りと中身と貴重品不在を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a small cat charm on the handle. Inside are a lunch box and a gray folding umbrella. There is no wallet or ID in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the cat charm, the contents, and the absence of valuables. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかのかばんと見分ける手がかりになりますね。乗った便や降りた停留所を説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will help distinguish it from other bags. Can you describe which service you took and the stop where you got off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十三時ごろ市役所前で降りました。便の番号はわからないので、乗った場所と時刻をメモして事業者に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停留所と時刻を伝え不明な便番号を問い合わせる方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I got off at the stop in front of City Hall around one p.m. I do not know the service number, so I will note where and when I boarded and ask the operator.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the stop and time, and say you will ask about the service number you do not know. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不確かな便の番号を決めつけず、その情報を伝えてください。見つかった場合の連絡先も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give them that information without assuming a service number you are unsure of. We will also confirm how to contact you if it is found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先は携帯電話です。事業者にも問い合わせ、見つかったらこちらへ連絡する必要があるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先と見つかった後の連絡方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: My contact number is my mobile. I will ask the operator too. Please also tell me whether I need to contact you here if it is found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your contact details and how to notify this office after it is found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 届け出後の連絡方法を順にご説明します。かばんが見つかるとよいですね。お帰りの際もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will explain the contact procedure after filing the report, step by step. I hope your bag is found. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。記載されている保管期限をご確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. Could you check the storage deadline written on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日までと書いてあります。昼は仕事で家にいないので、夜に再配達してもらえるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保管期限と夜間再配達の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says until tomorrow. I am at work and not home during the day, so I would like to know whether it can be redelivered at night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the storage deadline and your wish for evening redelivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず不在票の案内先で、選べる日時があるか確認しましょう。私の所で夜の枠が空いていると確約はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's check the contact or service listed on the notice for available dates and times. I cannot guarantee from here that an evening slot is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内の画面を開きました。明日の夜は選べません。窓口で受け取る方法も探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夜の選択肢がない状況と窓口受取希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have opened the page in the instructions. Tomorrow evening cannot be selected. I would also like to look for a way to collect it at a counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there is no evening option and you would like counter collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受け取り場所は、保管されている所と対応状況の確認が必要です。不在票に書かれた連絡先へ、来訪前にお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The collection location needs to be confirmed with the place holding it, along with whether they can handle collection. Please contact the number on the notice before visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、今日の仕事帰りに行けるか、保管場所と受付時間を電話で聞きます。本人確認の持ち物も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保管場所と受付時間と本人確認資料を照会する方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will call to ask where it is held and the opening hours, to see whether I can go after work today. I would like to check what to bring for identification too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about the storage location, opening hours, and identification documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。荷物の種類によって確認事項が変わる場合がありますので、通知番号も手元にご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. The items to confirm may vary with the type of parcel, so have the notice number ready too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号はこの欄ですね。もし今日受け取れなければ、期限について相談できるかも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知番号と期限相談の必要性を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number is in this field, right? If I cannot collect it today, I will also ask whether I can discuss the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the notice number and the need to discuss the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ただし、相談しただけで期限が延びたことにはなりません。案内された結果を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. However, merely discussing it does not mean the deadline has been extended. Please confirm the outcome you are given.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 再配達を申し込めたと思い込まず、電話で決まった日時か受取方法をメモします。今から案内先へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定した受取方法をメモし案内先へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume I have booked redelivery. I will note the date and time or collection method settled by phone. I will contact the service listed now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the confirmed collection method and contact the service listed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 不在票と番号をお忘れなく。受け取りのご相談が進むとよいですね。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Do not forget the notice and number. I hope you can make progress with arranging collection. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失についてのご相談ですね。どのカードかわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a lost card. Do you know which card it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この銀行のキャッシュカードです。財布は手元にありますが、カードだけ見当たりません。昨夜ATMを使ったあとから確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ATM後のキャッシュカード紛失を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is this bank's ATM card. I have my wallet, but I cannot find the card itself. I have not been able to locate it since using an ATM last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your ATM card has been missing since using the ATM. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 探すことと別に、利用停止の手続きを担当へつなぎます。お名前など本人確認に必要な情報を、こちらで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Separately from searching for it, I will connect you with the staff who handle blocking its use. Let's confirm your name and other information needed to verify your identity here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 利用停止をお願いします。カード番号はわかりませんが、通帳と身分証を持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 利用停止を求め番号不明と持参資料を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please block it. I do not know the card number, but I have my bankbook and ID.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request that the card be blocked, say you do not know the number, and state the documents you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちの資料で確認できる内容を担当へ伝えます。見覚えのない取引に気づいていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the staff what can be verified from your documents. Have you noticed any transactions you do not recognize?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ残高を確認していないので、ないとは言えません。停止のあとに、最近の取引も確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不正取引未確認と取引照会希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not checked the balance yet, so I cannot say there are none. After blocking it, I would like to check recent transactions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say unauthorized transactions have not yet been checked and you want to inquire about transactions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承りました。停止が完了したかは担当からの案内で確認してください。ここでお話を伺っただけでは完了にはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please confirm with the staff's instructions whether blocking is complete. Simply telling me about it here does not complete it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。家でカードが見つかっても、そのままATMで試さず、担当に使える状態かを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見つかったカードを試さず利用状態を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Even if I find the card at home, I will not just try it in an ATM; I will ask the staff whether it is in a usable state.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not try a found card but will confirm its usage status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。再発行や見つかった後の扱いも担当がご説明します。いまのご希望を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The staff will also explain replacement and how to handle the card if it is found. I will pass on your requests.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず停止が完了したと確認し、その次に取引と再発行を相談します。資料はこのまま持って担当の所へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止完了確認から取引と再発行へ進む順序を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will confirm that blocking is complete, then ask about transactions and a replacement. I will keep these documents with me and go to the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Set the order: confirm blocking is complete, then discuss transactions and replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お急ぎのご相談として引き継ぎます。通帳を忘れずにお進みください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on as an urgent inquiry. Please proceed without forgetting your bankbook. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 持参された缶詰について、状態を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask about the condition of the canned food you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝買った物です。家で見たらふたの縁が深くへこんでいました。買ったときからこうだったか、はっきり覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 深いへこみと発生時点不明を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought it this morning. When I looked at it at home, the rim of the lid was deeply dented. I do not clearly remember whether it was like this when I bought it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the deep dent and that you do not know when it happened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に開けずに持ってこられたのですね。レシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You brought it in without forcing it open, then. Do you have the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、これです。ほかの缶は大丈夫でした。この一個だけ、袋の中でも立ち方が不安定でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートと他缶との差を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. The other cans were fine. Only this one was unsteady even when standing in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and explain how this can differed from the others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入内容を確認します。交換できるかなどは担当に照会しますので、へこんだ缶をお預かりしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will confirm the purchase details. I will ask the responsible staff whether it can be exchanged and about other options. May I take the dented can?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 預けます。中身が安全か知りたくて開けようかと思いましたが、においだけでは判断できませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品を預け開封やにおいでの安全判断を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will leave it with you. I considered opening it because I wanted to know whether the contents were safe, but smell alone would not tell me, would it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hand over the product and ask about opening it and judging safety by smell. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この窓口で安全に食べられると断言はできません。状態を確認して、対応を担当から説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I cannot state at this counter that it is safe to eat. We will check its condition, and the responsible staff will explain how we can handle it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、この缶は食べません。同じ商品を買い直す場合も、ふたと底の状態を見てから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認の缶を食べず新商品も外観確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will not eat this can's contents. Even if I buy the same product again, I will check the lid and bottom before choosing one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not eat from the unchecked can and will also check the exterior of a new product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。お客様がへこませたとこちらで決めつけず、伺った経緯をそのまま伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will not assume here that you dented it; we will pass on the circumstances just as you described them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原因はわからないと伝えてください。レシートを手元に置いて、交換か返金かの説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原因を断定せず対応説明を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please tell them the cause is unknown. I will keep the receipt with me and wait for an explanation about exchange or refund.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume a cause and will wait for the explanation of how it will be handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 経緯を確認してまいります。お持ちいただきありがとうございました。いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will go and confirm the circumstances. Thank you for bringing it in. Please excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展望台への道を調べていらっしゃいますか。途中には坂もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the route to the observation deck? There are slopes along the way too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人は展望台まで行きたいそうですが、私は最近あまり歩いていません。途中で戻れる道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩行不足と途中で戻れる道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend wants to go to the observation deck, but I have not walked much recently. Please tell me a route where I can turn back partway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your lack of walking and ask for a route where you can turn back partway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用の地図では、坂の手前の東屋から入口へ戻れます。展望台まで行かず、東屋だけを目的地にもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice map, you can return to the entrance from the gazebo before the slope. You can also make just the gazebo your destination, without going to the observation deck.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず東屋まで歩き、そこで疲れ具合を確かめます。友人だけ先へ行ったら、どこで待てばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 東屋で疲れを確認し別行動の待機場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will walk to the gazebo first and assess how tired I am there. If only my friend goes on ahead, where should I wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will assess your tiredness at the gazebo and ask where to wait if you split up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 東屋で待つのか入口で合流するのか、出発前に決めてください。体調が悪くなったら、待ち合わせより安全を優先してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before setting out, decide whether you will wait at the gazebo or meet at the entrance. If you feel unwell, put safety before meeting up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口で合流する案にします。ただ、友人が戻るまで長く待つのは避けたいので、戻る時間を約束します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口合流と待ち時間の取り決めを提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will suggest meeting at the entrance. But I do not want to wait a long time for my friend to return, so we will agree on a return time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Propose meeting at the entrance and an agreement about waiting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お二人で時間を決め、途中でも変更を連絡できるようにしてください。東屋からは来た平らな道を戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Agree on a time between you, and make sure you can contact each other about changes along the way too. From the gazebo, you can return along the same flat path you came on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口へ戻るのに別の山道を使わず、来た道を使います。友人には、東屋で先へ進むか決めると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来た平坦路へ戻り東屋で進行可否を判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the path we came on to return to the entrance, rather than another mountain trail. I will tell my friend I will decide at the gazebo whether to go farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return along the same flat path and decide at the gazebo whether to continue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。坂を上り始めてから無理をするより、手前で相談していただくほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. It is better to discuss it beforehand than to push yourself after starting up the slope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人も東屋まで一緒に歩くことに賛成しました。そこで無理そうなら私は入口へ戻り、合流時刻を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者の合意と引返し時の合流確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend has agreed to walk together as far as the gazebo too. If continuing seems too much there, I will return to the entrance and confirm our meeting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your companion's agreement and that you will confirm the meeting arrangements if you turn back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお二人とも無理のない歩き方で。東屋まで気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please both walk at a pace you can manage without strain. Take care on the way to the gazebo, and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交通のご相談ですね。船の切符の購入先をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a transport inquiry. Are you looking for where to buy a boat ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、今日は一人で歩いて乗ります。車で乗る友人と同じ切符を買うのか、わかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩で一人乗船し車で乗る友人と券種が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Today I am boarding alone on foot. I do not know whether I should buy the same ticket as my friend who is boarding with a car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are boarding alone on foot and ask whether the ticket type is the same as for your friend with a car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 旅客の切符と車両の申込みは、案内を分けて確認しましょう。この窓口では発券せず、購入先をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the guidance for passenger tickets and vehicle applications separately. We do not issue tickets at this counter; we will tell you where to buy them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここでは買えないのですね。徒歩で一人乗る場合の購入案内を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内窓口では購入できないと確認し徒歩旅客の購入案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I cannot buy it here. Please show me the purchasing information for one person boarding on foot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you cannot buy at the information counter and request purchasing information for a foot passenger. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが旅客向けの案内です。購入先では、行き先と乗る便を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the information for passengers. At the place of purchase, please confirm your destination and which sailing to take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行き先はこの表示の場所です。乗り場へ慌てずに行ける便を選ぶには、何を聞けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的地を示し余裕のある便選びで何を聞くべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My destination is the place shown on this sign. What should I ask to choose a sailing that gives me time to reach the boarding point without rushing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate your destination and ask what to inquire about to choose a sailing with enough time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入窓口で乗り場までの移動と乗船の案内を確認し、余裕のある便を相談してください。運行状況もそこで確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: At the ticket counter, check how to reach the boarding point and the boarding instructions, and ask about a sailing that leaves enough time. Confirm the operating status there too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 購入前に、一人の旅客分だけで車両の申込みを含まないことも確認すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旅客一人分で車両申込みなしという購入条件の確認を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before purchasing, should I also confirm that it is for only one passenger and does not include a vehicle application?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about confirming the purchase conditions: one passenger and no vehicle application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その条件を伝えてください。こちらの案内には、問い合わせ先と購入先が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please state those conditions. This guide lists both the inquiry contact and the place of purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を持って購入先へ行き、徒歩の一人分と伝えます。乗り場への移動時間も聞いてから便を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を持って購入先へ行き徒歩一人分と移動時間を確認して便を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the guide to the place of purchase and say it is for one person on foot. I will ask about the time needed to reach the boarding point before deciding on a sailing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the guide to the place of purchase, confirm it is for one person on foot and the travel time to the boarding point, and decide on a sailing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 不明な点を確かめてからご購入ください。どうぞお気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please clarify anything you are unsure of before buying. Take care on your journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知で、わかりにくい箇所はどこでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the notice you brought is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つの日付が書いてあります。上の日付までに窓口へ来ないといけないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の二つの日付のうち上の日が来庁期限か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two dates written on it. Do I have to come to the office by the upper date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the upper of the notice's two dates is the deadline for visiting the office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 上は書類の提出期限、下は相談会の開催日と書かれています。まず見出しを分けて読みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The upper one says document submission deadline, and the lower one says the date of a consultation session. First, let's read the headings separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 提出期限と相談会の日は別なのですね。相談会に参加すれば、書類を出さなくてもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出と相談会は別と確認し参加が提出を代替するか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the submission deadline and consultation day are different. If I attend the session, does that mean I do not need to submit the documents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that submission and the session are separate, and ask whether attendance replaces submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この通知では別々の案内です。相談会への参加が提出の代わりになるとは書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: They are separate instructions on this notice. It does not say attending the session takes the place of submission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕事で相談会に行けません。必要な書類について、担当窓口へ電話で聞く方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談会に参加できず書類について電話で聞く方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot attend the session because of work. Is there a way to ask the responsible counter about the required documents by phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you cannot attend the session and ask how to inquire about the documents by phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知の下に担当の連絡先があります。必要事項を確認する電話相談について、そこでお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible department's contact details are at the bottom of the notice. Please ask them about a telephone consultation to confirm what is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話で話すために、通知のどの番号を手元に用意すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話相談用に準備する通知番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Which number on the notice should I have ready for the phone call?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which number on the notice to prepare for the telephone consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この照会番号があれば、担当者が通知を確認しやすくなります。提出方法も担当へ確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This reference number will make it easier for the staff to identify the notice. Please also check the submission method with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 照会番号を用意して電話します。相談会には行けないことと、期限までの提出方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照会番号を用意して相談会欠席と期限内提出方法を電話で確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will have the reference number ready and call. I will say I cannot attend the session and ask how to submit by the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to prepare the reference number and confirm by phone that you cannot attend the session and how to submit on time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認のうえ対応してください。こちらでのご案内は以上です。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please act after confirming the details. That is all the guidance I can give here. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 声を出すのがつらそうですね。必要なら、紙に書いてお伝えいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: It looks painful for you to speak. You can write things on paper to tell us if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝から声がかすれて、長く話すとのどが痛みます。短くなら話せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 声のかすれと話したときの痛み及び発症時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My voice has been hoarse since this morning, and my throat hurts if I talk for a long time. I can speak briefly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the hoarseness, pain when speaking, and when the symptoms started. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に続けなくて結構です。息がしづらい感じはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You do not need to force yourself to keep speaking. Do you feel any difficulty breathing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は息苦しさはありません。昨日からの様子をスマートフォンに書いてあるので、見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 息苦しさがないと答え症状メモの確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have no trouble breathing now. I have written how I have been feeling since yesterday on my smartphone; could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have no breathing difficulty and ask them to check your symptom notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見します。診察担当にも経過が伝わるようにします。お薬の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will take a look. I will make sure the clinical staff know the history too. Do you have information about your medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薬の手帳は家に置いてきました。昨夜飲んだ市販薬の箱なら、袋に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬の手帳はなく昨夜飲んだ市販薬の箱を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I left my medication notebook at home. But the box of the over-the-counter medicine I took last night is in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not have your medication notebook but brought the box of the over-the-counter medicine taken last night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱を見せてください。ほかに使っている薬があれば、名前や量がわかるものを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me the box. If you use any other medicines, let's check something showing their names and doses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普段の薬はありません。この箱と症状のメモを診察にも持っていけばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 常用薬なしと答え箱とメモを診察に持参すべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not take any regular medicines. Should I take this box and the symptom notes to the consultation too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you take no regular medicines and confirm whether to bring the box and notes to the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お持ちください。受付に必要なものは、窓口でも案内を確認していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please bring them. Please also check the instructions at the counter about what is needed for reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱とメモを手元に出しておきます。話しづらいところは、書いたものを見せて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱とメモを準備し話しづらい部分は筆談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will have the box and notes out and ready. For anything difficult to say, I will show what I have written to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare the box and notes, and communicate in writing where speaking is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それで結構です。受付のあと、お呼びするまでお待ちください。では、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: That is fine. After reception, please wait until you are called. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾ったものをお届けですか。どちらで見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you handing in something you found? Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布です。昼休みに海沿いの道で拾いましたが、通りの名前はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布を海沿いで拾ったが通り名は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a wallet. I found it on a road by the sea during my lunch break, but I do not know the street name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you found a wallet by the sea but do not know the street name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 地図で確認しましょう。近くに目印になるものはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check on the map. Were there any landmarks nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さな休憩所のベンチの下でした。ここから歩いて来た道を、地図でたどれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休憩所のベンチ下という目印を伝え地図で道を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was under a bench at a small rest area. I can trace the route I walked to get here on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the landmark of under a bench at a rest area and show the route on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、その道と休憩所を指してください。見つけた時刻も覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please point out the route and rest area. Do you remember when you found it too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯を見たときは十二時二十分でした。財布を拾ったのは、その直前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯時刻十二時二十分の直前に拾ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I looked at my phone, it was twelve twenty. I picked up the wallet just before that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you found it just before the phone showed twelve twenty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 十二時二十分ごろとして伺います。財布を見つけてから、ほかの方に渡したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record it as around twelve twenty. Since finding the wallet, have you handed it to anyone else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、私がそのまま持って来ました。中身は出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人に渡さず中身も出さず持参したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I brought it straight here myself. I have not taken out the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought it without handing it to anyone else or taking out the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。これから内容を確認して受付を進めます。連絡先の記入についてもご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will now check the contents and continue the intake process. I will also explain entering your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 目印と時刻を記録に残してください。連絡先の欄は、説明を聞いてから書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所と時刻の記録を求め連絡先説明後に記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please record the landmark and time. I will fill in the contact details field after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request a record of the location and time, and say you will enter contact details after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。財布はこちらでお預かりします。お届けいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will take the wallet here. Thank you for handing it in. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に関する手続きのご相談ですね。新しい住所はお手元で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss the procedure for moving. Can you check your new address from something you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番地はわかりますが、建物名の書き方に自信がありません。省いて申し込んでもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物名が不確かで省略して申込めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I know the lot number, but I am unsure how to write the building name. May I apply leaving it out?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are unsure of the building name and ask whether you can apply without it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 誤配を避けるため、正しい住所表記を確かめましょう。契約書などに住所は載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: To avoid misdelivery, let's confirm the correct written address. Is the address on your contract or another document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書には建物名と部屋番号まで載っています。帰宅したら、その表記を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書の建物名と部屋番号を帰宅後確認できると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The contract includes the building name and room number. I can check the way it is written when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can check the building name and room number on the contract after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その情報を用意してから、申込案内の記入欄と照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once you have that information ready, compare it with the fields in the application instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 転居するのは私だけです。以前の家に残る同居人の郵便まで移らないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分だけ転居し同居人の郵便は対象にしたくないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only I am moving. I want to make sure the mail for the person staying in our former home is not moved too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that only you are moving and you do not want your housemate's mail included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転居する方の情報を正確に記入する必要があります。対象者の扱いは案内に沿って一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You need to enter the moving person's details accurately. We can check together how the people covered are handled, following the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私だけが対象になる書き方を説明していただけますか。今日この場で提出するつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分だけを対象にする記入説明を求め今日は提出しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you explain how to fill it in so it covers only me? I do not intend to submit it here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request filling instructions that cover only you and say you will not submit it today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。この案内で対象者欄を確認しましょう。提出前に住所と対象者を見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Let's check the field for the people covered in this guide. Review the address and people covered before submitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を持ち帰り、契約書の建物名と部屋番号を確認して、自分の分だけ申込みを準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を持ち帰り正式住所と自分だけの対象情報を準備すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the guide home, check the building name and room number in the contract, and prepare an application for myself only.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take the guide home and prepare the official address and details covering only yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してからお手続きください。本日のご説明は以上です。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check before completing the procedure. That concludes today's explanation. Take care.
